name: Shinku
source:
A member of the Four Heavenly Kings, his specialty is martial arts.
An overconfident guy with a short temper who thinks everything can be solved with power.
He has the most fighting skill among the four kings, but he has a simple mind and is easily tricked.
He directly picked [url=/c46022]Hinatsu[/url] as a candidate, and spends his time living a survival lifestyle in the park.
